Device Name: Penumbra System®0 MAX
Indications for Use:
The Penumbra System is intended for use in the revascularization of patients with acute
isohemic stroke secondary to intracranial large vessel occlusive disease (in the internal
carotid, middle cerebral - MlI and M2 segments, basilar, and vertebral arteries) within 8
hours of symptom onset.
